decision_reasons: P12 validates local evaluator scale-up, per-row outcome parsing, failure summary, rollback evidence, and proof artifact writing across 10 rows.
P12 candidate rows are public reference-model replay, so they do not prove autonomous CP-Bench model generation or leaderboard competitiveness.
External submission would blur the product claim boundary before client-generated candidates are validated at similar scale.
required_before_submission_gate: Run a non-reference-replay P13 with client-generated or client-repaired candidates on at least 10 verified rows.
Record failure classifications, rollback evidence, and proposal context for every failed row.
Show that the generated candidate path improves over negative control without relying on public ground-truth model fields.
Pass path-leak checks, tests, and a human claim-boundary review.
claim_boundary: This decision intentionally defers Hugging Face upload. It is not a leaderboard score, ranking, or official submission.
